evidence.method: walk every node_modules under each root (depth <= 5), read package.json, skip @deepseek-ai/*; license from package.json with a LICENSE text sniff as cross-check
limits: caches and archives are not unpacked
the sweep is depth-bounded, so a deeply nested vendored tree can be missed
a package is counted once by directory
